title: Found Unconscious
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents found unconscious in an enclosed space with possible exposure (car exhaust, faulty heater, fire). Cherry-red skin, headache, confusion, nausea. CO binds hemoglobin with 240x affinity of O2 → carboxyhemoglobin (COHb) → impaired O2 delivery + cellular toxicity (binds cytochrome c oxidase). Pulse oximetry falsely NORMAL (cannot distinguish COHb from O2Hb). ABG: normal PaO2, elevated COHb (>3% nonsmokers, >10% smokers). Treatment: 100% oxygen via non-rebreather (reduces COHb half-life from 5h to 1h). Hyperbaric O2 if: COHb >25%, LOC, neurologic symptoms, cardiac ischemia, pregnancy. Monitor for delayed neurologic sequelae. Identify source — others at risk.
